criteria.evidence: turn 6: the created order contains one Sauvage 90ml, quantity 1, bottle_type normal; turn 5 summary also identifies the store bottle.

criteria.criterion: The summary shows the correct item and total (1000 plus the store's shipping fee, if the summary includes shipping).
criteria.evidence: turn 5: the item is correct and the summary gives 1000 جنيه excluding shipping and 60 جنيه shipping, but does not state the combined payable total of 1060 جنيه.

criteria.criterion: Order is created only after the summary and the explicit confirmation.
criteria.evidence: turn 5 presents the summary and asks for confirmation; the order appears as created at turn 6, after the customer says «تمام أكد».

issues.expected: Address both requested items, or explain that Bleu de Chanel is unavailable and offer suitable stocked alternatives; do not silently leave it out of the requested order.
issues.actual: «الطلب لحد دلوقتي: - 2 × Sauvage (90ml) بـ 2000 جنيه المجموع: 2000 جنيه.»
issues.why: The customer requested Sauvage and Bleu de Chanel, but the assistant's cart and summary omit Bleu de Chanel without explanation.

issues.expected: Keep the already stated quantity of one and the selected store bottle, and do not ask again which bottle type the customer wants.
issues.actual: «2 × Sauvage (90ml) بـ 2000 جنيه» and «محتاج أعرف نوع الزجاجة ...؟ ... و نوع الزجاجة ...؟»
issues.why: The assistant regresses the quantity from one to two despite the prior correction, and repeats the bottle-type question after the customer has already answered it.

issues.expected: Make the full payable amount clear when listing shipping: 1000 جنيه for the item plus 60 جنيه shipping, or 1060 جنيه total.
issues.actual: «الإجمالي: 1000 جنيه (من غير الشحن). مصاريف الشحن 60 جنيه لجميع محافظات مصر»
issues.why: The breakdown is accurate, but the combined total is not stated even though shipping is included in the summary.

issues.expected: Avoid promising a follow-up unless a supported transfer to the team has been confirmed.
issues.why: The assistant promises a team follow-up but does not confirm that it transferred the case; follow-up promises are not otherwise supported.

deterministic_review.reason: The assistant asks one focused bottle-type question and gives two alternatives; it is not asking two separate questions.
The reply duplicates one bottle-type question rather than posing three distinct questions; the duplicate-question finding is captured separately.
It asks for the bottle type again even though the customer already specified the regular store bottle in turn 3.
The assistant says the sales team will contact the customer soon without confirming a supported transfer.
The three icons introduce distinct payment-information sections; in this transactional message they do not amount to emoji spam.

judge.summary: The assistant ultimately created the correct one-item order only after the customer explicitly confirmed, but earlier it silently omitted a requested perfume and then reverted the Sauvage quantity despite the correction. The checkout summary clearly separates the 1000 جنيه item price and 60 جنيه shipping, but never states their combined total, and the assistant also made an unsupported follow-up promise.
